title: You Swear You Blocked Background Voices, Yet Your Own Mouth Followed the Ignored Ear
description:
You think your brain mutes background voices to zero! But one whispered name across a loud room grabs you! This is the true story of the Oxford ear swap study. Here is what went wrong with strict filter theories.
